sections.title: Contributors to population change in Mendip
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Mendip, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 4,125 people (−3.5%). In total, there were 9,472 births and 13,597 deaths in Mendip between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 10,961 (9.4%). There were 75,266 people entering the area and 64,305 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Mendip of 667 people (−0.6%), as a result of 3,427 people entering the area and 4,093 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Mendip's population of 600 (0.5%).as a result of 5,625 people entering the area and 5,025 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
